name: v1.1.2 - Fixed Preview Extraction & Enhanced Display
body:
## 🎉 Claude Conversation Extractor v1.1.2

### 🔥 Critical Fixes from v1.1.1

**v1.1.1 has been yanked** - it was published without the latest fixes. v1.1.2 includes all intended improvements.

### ✨ What's New
- **Fixed preview extraction** - Now correctly shows actual user messages, not system/assistant messages
- **Enhanced conversation display** - Shows ALL conversations by default with:
  - 💬 Message counts
  - 📝 Preview of first real user message  
  - 📅 Timestamps
  - 💾 File sizes
- **Improved search** - Fixed arrow key handling that was inserting weird characters
- **Better file organization** - Clean project structure

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed preview showing "extractor is running..." instead of user messages
- Fixed preview showing "This session is being continued..." (Claude's system messages)
- Fixed arrow keys in real-time search (macOS compatibility)
- Fixed command conflicts with old projects
- Resolved 'claude-logs not found' issues
- Now properly skips system messages to find real user queries

### 📦 Installation
```bash
pipx install claude-conversation-extractor
```

### 🚀 Quick Start
```bash
claude-start      # Interactive UI with real-time search
claude-extract    # CLI mode - now shows all conversations
claude-search     # Direct search command
claude-logs       # Still works for backward compatibility
```

Full changelog: https://github.com/ZeroSumQuant/claude-conversation-extractor/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.2
